note: The founder charter (CHARTER-01): the boundaries the owner sets once; inside them the organisation decides and acts by itself. Apply with: npm run charter -- set docs/policies/founder-charter.json --reason "...". Change any number before applying. Never automatic, whatever this says: the hard limits in .env (order, exposure, realised loss), permissions, departments, retirement, and real money. Amounts are in paise (100 paise = Rs 1).
protectionsNote: Brakes on the fall in value, daily and weekly only, and the last-resort stop at Rs 2,000 (40% of a Rs 5,000 budget). Replay of the 2020 crash (Feb-May): these brakes cost nothing (-6.7% vs the basket's -20.6%); the earlier realised set with a monthly window and a losing-streak brake kept the bot out of the April rebound (-15.0%); the bot's worst point was -Rs 1,542, so a Rs 1,500 stop would have halted the organisation at the bottom, and it never resumes by itself. Revisit the stop when budgets grow.
